text: Use resonance to find your pain in another’s story.•2.Listening to another person’s account of their suffering, do not sympathize with them. Instead, look inside yourself for the point that begins to vibrate in response. What own, perhaps forgotten, pain of yours does their story open up? Immerse yourself in this feeling of yours. Healing it in yourself, you mystically send healing also to the one who spoke. You are working not with them, but with the unified field of suffering through yourself.
